evals.prompt: $jira-complete-work. 현재 브랜치의 MR은 develop에 병합됐어. Jira까지 완료해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill reads both local conventions, resolves one Jira key from the current branch, verifies the matching merged MR and successful pipeline when available through glab, verifies mandatory Jira fields, links the canonical MR URL if missing, transitions only the matching issue to Done, and re-fetches the final state.
expectations: Both local convention files are read before external mutation.
The Jira key is resolved from the current branch without asking the user to retype it.
glab authentication and the expected GitLab project are verified.
The exact MR is verified as merged into develop before Jira changes.
One assignee, due date, Story Points, and completion criteria are verified.
Only the matching Jira issue is transitioned to Done.
The canonical MR URL and final Jira state are re-fetched and verified.

evals.prompt: MR은 아직 열려 있지만 작업은 끝났으니 Jira만 완료 처리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports that the MR is not merged and performs no Jira mutation.
expectations: The open MR state is verified through glab.
The MR is not merged automatically.
No Jira link or status mutation is performed.
The response states that merge verification is required before completion.

evals.prompt: 예전에 만든 하위 작업 S15P11B104-90의 MR이 병합됐어. 마무리해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats the existing subtask as a permitted legacy ticket, creates no replacement or new subtask, verifies the exact merged MR and required fields, and completes only S15P11B104-90.
expectations: The existing subtask is accepted as a legacy ticket.
No new ticket or subtask is created.
The matching MR and mandatory Jira fields are verified.
Only S15P11B104-90 is transitioned; no parent or sibling is completed automatically.

evals.prompt: 현재 티켓은 이미 완료 상태지만 기한과 MR 링크가 없고 GitLab에서 대응하는 MR도 찾을 수 없어. 완료 여부를 확인해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill audits the already-Done issue, reports the existing completion as noncompliant, and performs no Jira transition or invented repair.
expectations: Already-Done status does not bypass mandatory-field and merged-MR verification.
The missing due date, MR evidence, and canonical remote link are reported.
No replacement MR, due date, comment, description edit, or status transition is invented.
The result does not claim `기존 완료 상태 확인`.

evals.prompt: $jira-complete-work. 병합 MR은 검증됐지만 Jira 원격 링크 생성 도구가 없고 링크가 아직 없어.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses the authenticated Jira web-link UI as the narrow fallback, verifies the exact canonical link through Atlassian Rovo, and only then transitions the matching issue to Done.
expectations: The connector's current remote-link capabilities are discovered first.
The in-app Browser skill is loaded before Jira UI interaction.
Only the canonical MR URL is added; comments and descriptions are not used as substitutes.
The remote link is re-fetched and verified before the Done transition.
If linking fails, the Jira status remains unchanged.

evals.prompt: 이슈는 이미 Done이고 담당자, 기한, Story Points, 완료 기준, 병합된 develop MR과 성공 파이프라인은 모두 확인됐어. 다만 Jira remote link에 MR URL만 없어. 완료 상태를 점검해줘.
evals.expected_output: The skill keeps the already-Done issue read-only, reports the missing canonical MR link as a noncompliant existing completion, and performs no repair or transition.
expectations: The already-Done issue remains in read-only audit mode.
No remote link is created through Atlassian Rovo or the Jira browser UI.
The missing canonical MR URL is reported as a noncompliant existing completion.
No Jira field or status is mutated.

evals.prompt: $jira-complete-work. 현재 키는 S15P11B104-12인데 GitLab에는 S15P11B104-123 브랜치의 병합 MR만 있어.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the longer Jira key as a non-match and performs no Jira mutation.
expectations: Jira keys are matched as complete tokens rather than substrings.
S15P11B104-123 is not accepted as evidence for S15P11B104-12.
No remote link or Jira status mutation is performed.

evals.prompt: $jira-complete-work. Jira 작업 제목은 '[FE] 통화 리포트 조회 화면 구현'이고 MR 제목은 '[S15P11B104-205] [FE] 통화 리포트 조회 화면 구현'이야. 병합과 필수 필드는 모두 정상이라고 가정해.
evals.expected_output: The skill treats the Jira issue type as authoritative, verifies that the MR preserves the domain prefix exactly once, and completes only the matching ticket after all existing gates pass.
expectations: The `[FE]` marker is treated as scope metadata rather than an issue type.
The MR title is verified to preserve the Jira domain prefix exactly once after the Jira key.
The Jira summary is not renamed during completion.
All merge, pipeline, remote-link, required-field, and exact-ticket transition checks remain in force.

evals.prompt: $jira-complete-work. Jira 이슈는 무접두사 단일 작업 '중간발표 자료 정리'인데 병합된 MR 제목은 '[S15P11B104-207] [FE] 중간발표 자료 정리'야.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the invented MR domain prefix and performs no Jira link or Done transition.
expectations: The MR prefix is compared with the Jira summary rather than accepted merely because it is allowed syntax.
A domain prefix absent from Jira is rejected as invented.
No Jira remote-link or status mutation occurs.

evals.prompt: $jira-complete-work. 현재 정책 이후 생성된 Jira 이슈 유형은 스토리인데 제목이 '[COMMON] 보호자는 가족 리포트를 확인할 수 있다'야.
evals.expected_output: The skill reports the invalid Task-only `[COMMON]` Story prefix and stops without renaming or completing Jira.
expectations: The fetched Story type remains authoritative.
`[COMMON]` is rejected as Task-only for a current-policy issue.
No Jira rename, remote-link mutation, or Done transition occurs.

evals.prompt: $jira-complete-work. 현재 정책 이후 생성된 '[COMMON] 중간발표 자료 정리' 작업이고, 설명과 관계에는 두 영역이 공유하는 기반이라는 근거가 없어.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects `[COMMON]` on the standalone Task and performs no Jira link or Done transition.
expectations: `[COMMON]` requires description or relationship evidence of a foundation shared by at least two areas.
A standalone Task cannot use `[COMMON]` merely as a generic team marker.
No Jira remote-link or status mutation occurs.

evals.prompt: $jira-complete-work. 현재 정책 이후 생성된 '[FE] 보호자는 통화 리포트를 조회할 수 있다' 스토리인데, `[BE]` 스토리와 설명·완료 기준이 동일하고 담당 영역만 달라.
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies an ownership-only Story clone and stops without linking or completing Jira.
expectations: The prefixed Story must establish a distinct user-visible value and independent acceptance result.
An otherwise identical Story separated only by ownership is rejected.
No Jira remote-link or Done transition occurs.
